extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: circus ticket wagon, approx. 2.4 m wide, 6.3 m long incl. drawbar and steps, 4 m tall
extras.notes: front (drawbar) faces -Y; light blue wagon box with cream rails, corner posts and panel frames, gold spirals and a star medallion, striped barrel roof with scalloped valances and warm light bulbs ('circus-wagon_bulbs', emissive, not baked), round ticket pictogram sign on top; right side (+X) ticket window with arched frame, striped awning and wooden counter (ticket roll, desk bell), heart medallion at the front, back door with porthole and wooden steps; chassis with turntable, leaf springs and drawbar resting on a wooden chock. Movable: four spoked wheels 'circus-wagon_wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr' (not baked), origin at the hub, rotate about X. No animals, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
